test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 27 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: With which of the following institutes did the Data Informatics and Innovation Division of the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI), sign a Memorandum of Understanding under the Data Innovation lab initiative in January 2025?

options.text: International Institute of Information Technology – Hyderabad(IIIT-Hyderabad)

solution:
The correct answer is __**Indraprastha Institute of Information Technology (IIIT-Delhi)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Data Informatics and Innovation Division** of the **Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)** signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with **Indraprastha Institute of Information Technology (IIIT-Delhi)** under its **Data Innovation Lab initiative** in **January 2025**.
 
• This collaboration aims to leverage the expertise of IIIT-Delhi in **data science, machine learning, and artificial intelligence** to enhance the quality and utility of statistical data collected by MoSPI.
 
• The **Data Innovation Lab initiative** was introduced to foster partnerships between the government and academic institutions to promote **data-driven decision-making** and innovation.
 
• IIIT-Delhi is renowned for its strong focus on **research and development** in emerging technologies and its contribution to **data analytics and informatics** projects.
 
• The initiative is expected to facilitate the development of **advanced analytical tools**, enhance data collection methodologies, and provide solutions to complex statistical challenges faced by MoSPI.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Indraprastha Institute of Information Technology (IIIT-Delhi):**

 
 
• Established in **2008**, located in **New Delhi, India**.
 
• Specializes in **computer science, electronics, communications, and informatics**.
 
• Known for its strong emphasis on **research-oriented learning** and collaboration with industry and government bodies.
 
• Contributes significantly to projects involving **data science, artificial intelligence, and computational biology.**
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI):**
 
 
• Responsible for the collection, analysis, and dissemination of **statistical data** in India.
 
• Oversees national surveys such as the **National Sample Survey (NSS)** and works on **GDP estimation**.
 
• Plays a pivotal role in **policy formulation** by providing statistical insights to the government.
 
 
 
• **Data Innovation Lab Initiative:**
 
 
• A project launched by MoSPI to enhance **data management and innovation**.
 
• Focuses on utilizing **academic partnerships** to develop tools for better analysis and visualization of data.
 
• Aims to improve the **accessibility, reliability, and utility** of government data for policy-making and planning.
 
 
 
• **Applications of Data Analytics in Governance:**
 
 
• Facilitates informed decision-making by analyzing **large datasets**.
 
• Helps in tracking progress on **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)**.
 
• Enables prediction and mitigation of **socio-economic challenges**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **National Statistical System:**

 
 
• India's statistical system is one of the largest in the world, involving multiple agencies and departments.
 
• MoSPI ensures the coordination of data collection across **states and sectors**.
 
 
 
• **Role of Academic Institutions:**
 
 
• Institutions like IIIT-Delhi contribute to improving **data accuracy and analytical methodologies**.
 
• They provide training for government personnel in **advanced data techniques**.
